<b>Imobas</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are drifting bugs that are accustomed to their calm environment and react little to threats.<ref>Imoba [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Slow drifting bug with a heavy top shell. The bug reacts little to threats, even those that could claim its life."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Imobas drift idly back and forth in the area they inhabit, dealing {{Damage|1}} on contact. They are less of an enemy to fight and more of an obstacle to [[Needle#Needle-bouncing|Needle-bounce]] off during the ascent to the surface. Imobas' backs are armoured and cannot be damaged from above with [[Needle]] strikes or most [[Tools]], meaning they must be attacked from below or from the sides. If one is killed, another will drift in to replace it.

== Location ==
Imobas can be found in the upper part of the [[Border Caves]].
